mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to red cells was most worthwhile because it showed oxygen can attach and later be released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding white cells and platelets was straightforward from the unfilled outlines, but their individual roles were only briefly explained.

surprise.text: I noticed that the mature red cells had no nuclei, unlike the developing cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue because seeing how blood carries different materials made me curious about what happens next, though the assembly choices were mostly predictable.
